name: loopd-mod-pane
displayName: loopd — pane (a mod that draws the board inside the session)
description: COMPANION, a mod. /board opens a pane that draws this bundle's board — in-flight tasks, the need-you rail, per-project counts, the last snapshot time — from .loopd/SNAPSHOT.json in the session's working directory, re-read every 5 s only when its mtime moved. A fourth renderer over the snapshot writer's contract: it reads the snapshot, never the bundle, and carries nothing the snapshot does not. Two buttons: Tick submits /loopd:dispatch in THIS session, Refresh re-reads. No model call, no permission decision, no process, no network, no write. Not installed = the three core renderers are all there is.
